corrections_and_conventions: Positive loss L = -P&L; risk-measure axioms translated consistently to loss convention.
VaR is a quantile, not the worst possible loss; continuous/discrete exceedance distinction.
ES uses integrated quantiles; equal-weight empirical tail includes fractional boundary mass and handles ties.
Normal P&L is distinct from lognormal prices; nonlinear positions require revaluation or an appropriate approximation.
IID additive horizon approximation scales mean by T and SD by sqrt(T); logarithmic compounding and autocovariance stated.
Q-Q plotting positions (i-.5)/N avoid infinity; Q-Q does not establish temporal independence.
Histogram counts and density separated; 1+simple return, rather than simple return itself, is lognormal when log returns are normal.
Portfolio inputs are daily; full weights [488,135,315]/938; no premature weight rounding.
Basel historical green 0–4, yellow 5–9, red >=10; not presented as universal current regulation.

conventions.empirical_quantile: inverse empirical CDF, order ceil(N*c), roundoff correction at integer ranks
conventions.empirical_es: average worst N*(1-c) observations with fractional boundary weight
